basic_info.description: 1 bedroom, 1 bath, Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 people = $104,892; 2 people = $119,892 ; 3 = $134,844; Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and CommunityDevelopment (MOHCD), & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, July 12, 2022. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on August 4, 2022  Property is on first come first serve basis.  NEW PRICE!!
